title: A decision trail's checkpoint
description: Informative, at draft maturity. The checkpoint of spec/checkpoint-witness.md section 2: an object of exactly four members, the checkpoint line the reference runtime prints for one record of a trail. Core section 1.1 does not list this schema among the normative artifacts, so publishing it changes no format's normative status; where it and the prose differ, the prose controls and the difference is a specification defect. Outside it: that each member is given once, that the line is in the canonical form of section 1 and is not re-encoded, and every rule about number literals.

sequence.description: The record's line number in the trail, from 1 to 2^53-2.

recordDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the record line's exact bytes, without its newline.
